name: Independent panoptic range with retained native multimodal identity
cohort: all 9 opened-development scenes, all 67 targets and 268 queries
source_observations: same 1107 legal source frames, original 640-pixel RGB and mesh/depth projection
teacher: cached upstream FC-CLIP plus Mask-Adapter full model, fixed upstream COCO inference vocabulary
teacher_path: whole-image panoptic proposals, additional to original interactive SAM masks
teacher_parameters: upstream config: overlap 0.8, object score threshold 0.0, 250 learned model queries; no added output cap
identity: original native coordinates, all original region candidates and original text/image seed retained
scope: bind identity seed to geometrically containing entity; two-view physical scope else freshly computed v8; points use entity co-membership
query_access: map only, no source RGB/depth/SAM and no modality pairing
parameter_search: one fixed pretrained panoptic configuration, no benchmark-specific category list or tuning
decision: Completed all 1107 source frames and all 268 queries. Added scope increases coverage and false membership; no net improvement, do not promote.
